messages:
Eli: launching migration: create index CONCURRENTLY on events((metadata->>'tenant_id')) WHERE archived = false. starting canary on 5 hosts. DeployBot scheduled the job.
DeployBot: deployment 1819990000: migration 'concurrent_idx_events_tenant' queued. Canary group: prod-canary-5. Status: started.
Priya: heads-up: this is a CONCURRENT index build, should avoid heavy write spikes. setting backfill rate-limit to 50rps.
Eli: rate-limit -> 50rps applied. pin frontend -> commit `d4f9e1` for the window.
DeployBot: pin applied: route=prod/frontend image=d4f9e1. backfill_rate=50.
Sam: telemetry: canary-db-3 shows short lock queue surges during index DDL step, p99 lock wait ~2.7s. not huge but noticed.
eng-sre-bot: snapshot: canary cluster CPU spiked 40% during index scans, write latency p95 +18%. recommend slow ramp and increased sampling.
Priya: let's hold ramp. Eli, please switch index build to CONCURRENT + parallel_workers=1 (lower contention) and resume canary after 5m.
Eli: setting parallel_workers=1.
DeployBot: migration config updated: parallel_workers=1.
Sam: after change, lock waits dropped to p99 ~1.1s, CPU back to baseline. ready to lift to 20% traffic.
Eli: rolling to 20% now. alert if error_rate > 0.5% or if lock wait > 1.5s sustained for 3m.
DeployBot: rollout to 20% succeeded. Index build progressing.
Priya: we are seeing occasional long-running auto-vacuum conflicts on canary-db-4 causing schema lock waits. tagging eng-sre.
eng-sre-bot: detected relation-level lock held by autovacuum worker for >4m on events_shard_07. pgrep list attached. Suggest pausing autovacuum on shard and allowing index step to finish or terminating backend if >6m.
Sam: recommend pause_autovacuum for affected shards, then resume after index. Priya, Eli — approve?
Priya: approve pause_autovacuum on 07 and 09. Eli, make sure to record the pause in release notes.
Eli: pausing autovacuum on shards 07,09. command: `ALTER TABLE events_shard_07 SET (autovacuum_enabled = false);` will run on canary nodes only.
DeployBot: autovacuum pause executed on canary nodes.
Sam: index apply completed on canary nodes. full verification: sample queries + write smoke passed. CPU fine.
Eli: starting gradual roll to 50% now. keep close eye on long tail locks.
DeployBot: rollout in progress: increment -> 50%.
eng-sre-bot: alarm: across non-canary replicas, observed distributed lock wait spike p99=3.8s correlating with index finalize step. This is happening on a subset of primary DBs.
Priya: that's bad. reverting ramp. Eli, trigger rollback plan 'index-abort-rewind' and unpin frontend to previous stable tag.
Eli: initiating rollback. rollback command:
```
./deploy rollback --id 1819990000 --target-tag stable-202606
```
DeployBot: rollback started. rollout halted. index build cancellation signaled; note that CONCURRENT index cancellation may leave partially built index to be cleaned up.
Sam: DB ops will run `DROP INDEX IF EXISTS CONCURRENTLY partial_events_tenant_tmp` if left behind, after confirming no active locks. prepping kill list if needed.
Eli: DocsBot, add note to release page: aborted due to cross-region lock spike; action items: investigate autovacuum interaction, test lower parallel_workers default, and add autoretry for CONCURRENT builds in deployer.
DocsBot: release note updated: https://redwood.internal/releases/1819990000/notes (status: aborted).
Priya: follow-up: add a preflight check for autovacuum frequency and a flag to automatically pause autovacuum on canary only. Also add runbook step to escalate to DB oncall if p99 lock wait >3s for >5m.
Eli: noted. collecting traces, explain plans, and scheduling postmortem. thanks all. :pray:
